purpose: Close the gap between the already-falsified boolean NEAR_MISS Hamming count and the raw distance-to-current-threshold evidence required for future setup-scarcity research.

sourceContract.precedence: B if B.pass, else A if A.pass
sourceContract.currentNearMissLimitation: global top-12 after redundant missingCount/nearScore ranking

outputs: A/B exact check booleans and six-bit masks
nearestChannel=A/B/TIE based only on failed-check count
raw continuous margins to every decomposable current threshold
pool x nearest-channel x check-pattern descriptive summary

structuralFindings.aVolumeOrGate: A volume is volumeTodayVsPrev5<=1.05 OR volumeContraction5to20<=0.95; no single raw distance is semantically valid.
structuralFindings.bNotLateRedundancy: With buildMarketFeatures lateStage=(ret20>35 OR maDistance20Pct>25), B's additional ret20<=30 makes the ret20>35 lateStage arm non-binding. Under coherent raw features, B notLate is ret20<=30 AND maDistance20Pct<=25.
structuralFindings.aVolumeZeroTruthiness: Formal `(toNumber(volumeTodayVsPrev5)||999)` maps exact zero to sentinel 999. Observer exposes raw and effective values instead of hiding this edge case.
structuralFindings.missingUpperShadowTruthiness: Formal `(toNumber(dailyUpperShadowRatio)||0)` maps missing to zero/pass, but valid buildMarketFeatures normally computes this field. Observer warns if missing rather than treating it as clean evidence.

nonClaims: No threshold is relaxed or recommended.
nearestChannel is Hamming-only, not geometric/economic distance.
No normalized composite distance score is created.
Pattern counts are not sequential setup-first-failure denominators unless caller separately proves earlier Formal gates were cleared.
No outcome, return, MFE/MAE, BUY or selection-alpha data are used.
nextEvidence: Pair this observer with channel_stage_denominator_observer on prospective same-scan rows.
If owner later approves Class-B persistence, save full setup-first-failure population counts before bounded sampling.
Only after clean prospective dates test whether raw margin adds information beyond check identity and whether any check has stable protection/opportunity-cost value.
